scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The core identity is obtained directly from the printed model equations and is independently replayable with exact rational arithmetic for an explicit witness.
scientific limitations/integrity.limitations: The result diagnoses the sign failure of the published Lyapunov candidate on the theorem's stated feasible region. It does not disprove global stability in the remaining parameter interval and does not exclude an alternative proof.

title: The published \(R_0<1\) Lyapunov estimate is not sign-definite on its stated feasible region
